name: DynamicLake
tagline: Bring your music, messages, file actions, and system updates together around your Mac’s notch.
description:
DynamicLake turns the area around a MacBook notch into an interactive surface for media, notifications, files, timers, and system status. It also supports non-notch MacBooks and external displays, so its controls are not limited to one hardware shape.

The app is built as a collection of focused modules. DynaMusic handles playback, DynaGlance surfaces calendar and weather information, while DynaDrop and DynaClip help hold, move, share, preview, compress, or convert files without keeping another Finder window open.

## Features

- Control Apple Music, Spotify, and other supported media sources from a compact player with artwork, queue, progress, and playback controls.
- Surface iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, FaceTime, and iPhone call activity near the notch when the relevant integration is enabled.
- Hold multiple dragged files in DynaDrop, then share, AirDrop, create a link, or convert supported document, image, audio, and video formats.
- Manage files through DynaClip with Quick Look, compression, folder moves, sharing, and AirDrop actions.
- Show calendar, weather, battery, charging, Bluetooth-device, keyboard, brightness, volume, and macOS Timer information in glanceable modules.
- Place a slim or floating version on Macs without a notch and on external displays.

## Where it fits

DynamicLake suits people who want one visually integrated place for status, media, notifications, and lightweight file actions. It is broader than a simple notch media controller, but that breadth also means setup can feel busy; enabling only the modules that remove real friction keeps the interface useful.

## Privacy and requirements

DynamicLake requires macOS 14 or later and supports MacBooks with or without a notch. The developer states that it does not collect personally identifiable information and that message processing and quick replies happen locally, but the app needs macOS permissions for features such as notifications, messaging, files, and system control. The developer also warns that unofficial messaging integrations may conflict with a service's terms, so those modules should be evaluated before use.

## Pricing

DynamicLake costs $13.99 as a one-time purchase for up to three devices. The seller currently offers a 14-day refund period.
